Tool gap risk: tool_availability is represented, but no detailed availability/gap list is visible; later verification/backend stages could plan unavailable real tools unless a gap list is produced now.
Board/app-shell risk: no backend target discovery evidence is supplied at this stage, so board target names or app-shell integration points must not be guessed from sample projects or diagnostics.
